home.title: Understand your cycle. Prepare for your doctor.
home.body: Answer a few questions about your cycle, symptoms, and health history. We'll calculate a personalised PCOS risk score and generate a summary you can bring to your gynaecologist.
home.disclaimer: This tool does not diagnose PCOS. It's a starting point for a conversation with your doctor.

intro.title: HerCycle Screening Questionnaire
intro.body: A few questions about your cycle and any symptoms you've noticed. This takes about 3 minutes and does not diagnose PCOS — it estimates likelihood, based on the Rotterdam criteria, and prepares a summary you can bring to a clinician.

2.label: Section B · Signs of High Androgen

menarcheYears.title: How long ago was your first period?

cycleLength.title: On average, how many days between the start of one period and the next?

periodsLast12.title: How many periods have you had in the last 12 months?

gone3mo.title: Have you gone 3+ months without a period, and you're sure you're not pregnant?

acne.title: Acne that hasn't responded to normal skincare (jaw, chin, chest, or back)?

excessHair.title: Hair growth on your face, chest, or stomach that feels like more than typical for your family?
excessHair.help: Normal hair growth patterns vary a lot by background — compare to your own family, not a general standard.

scalpThin.title: Any thinning hair or a receding hairline on your scalp?

priorHormone.title: Has a doctor ever tested your hormone levels (like testosterone)?

weightChange.title: Noticeable weight change in the past year you can't explain?

skinPatches.title: Dark, velvety patches of skin on your neck, armpits, or groin?

familyHistory.title: Does your mother, sister, or aunt have PCOS, type 2 diabetes, or irregular periods?

toldPCO.title: Has a doctor ever told you, from an ultrasound, that you have polycystic ovaries?

onMedication.title: Are you currently on any hormonal medication (like birth control)?
onMedication.help: This affects how reliable the rest of your answers are, since hormonal medication changes cycles and skin.

tier.high: Higher likelihood — worth a clinician visit

results.medicationCaveat: You're on hormonal medication, so these results may be less reliable — mention this to a clinician.
results.disclaimer: Prototype for internal validation only — not a diagnostic tool.

pdf.disclaimerNote: Note: Criterion 3 (polycystic ovaries) relies on prior clinical diagnosis reported by the patient, not an independent ultrasound finding. This is a screening estimate, not a diagnosis.
